_comment: Spec 109 D35 (T161). Resolved value of every nullable (*bool) config key that has a Settings toggle. Decoded by internal/config/settings_nullable_defaults_test.go (pins each value to the Go resolver) and frontend/tests/unit/settings-nullable-defaults.spec.ts (pins fields.ts to it). A plain value applies when the key is absent. The audit_log.* keys depend on whether the audit_log block is present, and for an absent block on the edition: the personal edition leaves audit logging off, the server edition (HTTP transport) turns it on with a stdout sink. not_in_settings lists *bool keys that have no Settings toggle.
